tells.1: A stacked comfort list (kettle, catch your breath, spoonful) and a stock em-dash closer ('glad to have you along').
tells.2: Even, frictionless pacing and the vague collaborative line 'talk through the practicalities together'.
tells.3: Sympathy said twice ('not alone', then 'same boat') plus webinar-ish 'glad you're here'.
tells.4: Empty filler ('glad to have you along') and a 'Wherever you are' clause that doesn't fit the invitation.

reason: Version 1 has the most lived-in club voice, including the 'Well,' and a real slip a person would leave in. Version 2 is the one to send: it keeps that warmth, puts the welcome first, and states the workshop and fondant without the buried greeting or padded sympathy.
